results.note: its semantic analysis holds the only action thread (actionHandlerThreadCount 1) for the backend's 8 s; identical prompts are answered from the completion cache after that

30 forwards at once: each one's continuation waits for the thread, first come first served; once it is free, each continuation submits its analysis behind the remaining continuations, so the first 16 fill the backlog (max(16, 4 x 1 thread)) and the other 14 are shed
